result.summary: Identified two minor UI issues concerning text overflow and component spacing.

issues.description: Text truncation occurs for 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the horizontal restaurant list.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line text or use dynamic font scaling for longer titles.

issues.description: Notification badge in the top right header is positioned too close to the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Increase padding to align with the app's horizontal margins.
